description: She can make you do whatever she wants and you'll believe it was your idea. She could be a mystical being, or a scientific oddity. Whatever she is, beware her presence. As the flower's bouquet can captivate a fly, so can Black Orchid control your mind - and your soul. Reporter Walt Maddocks has made it his business to find people who don't want to be found. His current subject of scrutiny is Flora Black, a woman who briefly achieved fame when she saved a high-profile political candidate from an assassin's bullet. No one has seen her since, but Maddocks is convinced that she has connections to a professional escort named Blackie, and just possibly the mysterious Black Orchid. A wise prankster? A naive demigoddess? A corrupting influence or a sweet inspiration? Whatever she is, whatever you might think she is, Black Orchid can change your mind - sometimes forever.
Exultant in her newfound sexuality, Black Orchid tests it with Jiri, a young Amazon tribesman whose dalliance with a goddess has unexpected consequences.

issue_title: Suzy and the Trade of Fates
description: Suzy, the young Black Orchid, escapes Free Country and pursues the traitorous trickster, Junkin Buckley, through the Nexus. And Black Orchid, newly enlightened about her heritage, returns to Tennessee to tell Nick of Sherilyn's fate.

Hellbent on exacting one final bit of retribution for Sherilyn's fate, Black Orchid snares Logos CEO Eliot Weems in a web of romantic deception only to discover that Weems is playing an integral role in the propagation of her kind.

Back in New York City, Walt Brody, the investigative reporter who was shot while attempting to track down Black Orchid, is trying to overcome the psychological ramifications of his encounter with the extraordinary. Help comes to him from an unlikely source - the lost spirit of the young Amazonian tribesman, Jiri.

Black Orchid travels to England and is ensnared by a witch-hag named Black Annis, who prevents the Orchid from securing an interdimensional portal that has remained untended since the death of its guardian nymph.

issue_title: A Walk On the Wyrd Side
description: Black Orchid and the oak sprite Tanawah are drawn to New York City by the powerful magical signal emanating from an enchanted cauldron, which if possessed by three centuries-old evil spirits could spell disaster for all.
Suzy, the young Black Orchid, enters the labyrinthine archipelago of the Splintered Lands and searches one surreal isle after another for the elusive and mischievous Junkin Buckley.

issue_title: The Siting Of Her Groves A Tweisted Season Part One
description: Part 1 of the 6-part 'A Twisted Season.' The Black Orchid has been playing gardener all over the world, sowing strange seeds in secret groves. Now, her plants are sprouting - strange, disturbing, misshapen things - and the Orchid herself is showing signs of a brutal transformation.

issue_title: A Twisted Season, Part 2: Finality's Flower
description: Part 2 of the 6-part 'A Twisted Season.' Black Orchid's strange seedlings flourish even as her own dark metamorphosis continues.

issue_title: To Dream of the Dead A Twisted, Part III
description: Part 3 of the 6-part 'A Twisted Season.' Shattered by the sudden deaths of her groves, Black Orchid slips into a dream world outside linear time, where dead friends offer grim warnings about her future.
To evade the agents of a mysterious and sinister corporation, Black Orchid must test the limits of her mind-manipulating abilities.

issue_title: A Twisted Season Part Four Suzy And The Masks Of God
description: Part 4 of the 6-part 'A Twisted Season.' New York City has become the battleground for Black Orchid's final struggle with the darkness growing within her.

issue_title: A Twisted Season Part Five The Last Days
description: Part 5 of the 6-part 'A Twisted Season.' Black Orchid's icy grip on Manhattan continues to tighten, while Tanawah, Torben and the Kobolds make a last-ditch attempt to stop the chaos.

issue_title: A Twisted Season, Part 6: End of the Season
description: Final issue. Part 6 of the 6-part 'A Twisted Season.' In the shocking series climax, Suzy and Black Orchid are reunited in New York City's Central Park where they face each other in a deadly final conflict that will determine what the future holds for each of them.
With Logos in pursuit, Black Orchid and Sherilyn flee into a mysterious forest, the home of a deadly contagion the Orchid must destroy to save her friend's life.
Ignorance is bliss, or so Sherilyn suspects when a man named Nick tells her the strange and prophetic tale about his encounter with the Black Orchid.

Black Orchid and Sherilyn, still on the run from the Logos Corporation, journey into the heart of the Louisiana Bayou in search of the Swamp Thing. There they find a weird, twisted landscape warped by the Earth Elemental's subconscious mind. Continues in Swamp Thing (1982 2nd Series) #139.
With the lethal agents of Logos still in pursuit, Black Orchid and Sherilyn arrive in San Antonio, Texas, and stumble into a magical snare set by an ambitious adept in Native American mysticism.
Black Orchid turns the tables on the corporate thugs who have pursued her across two continents.

issue_title: Clicks And Silence Frogs And Mahogany
description: Heartbroken over the death of someone close, Black Orchid is led by a tribal elder to an ancient magical site in the Brazilian rain forest in a quest for her identity.

issue_title: The Murmuring of Mists, The Whisper of Flowers
description: While living among the Silent People of the Amazon, Black Orchid discovers her true lineage as part of an ancient race of nymphs and dryads - the female counterparts of Earth's other elementals.

Following up on last years hugely successful "Strange New Worlds" photonovel, John Byrne once again sets sail aboard the Starship: Enterprise, this time with an ongoing, bi-monthly series that begins by going through the looking glass to tell the story of what happened after the classic "Mirror, Mirror" episode of the original series. The crew discovers two strangers in their midst, and quickly learns that one has made a pact with one of James Kirk's oldest foes. "The Mirror, Cracked" is the title, and the action unfolds in May!

You met him as the navigator on the Bridge, but what roles did Pavel Chekov play aboard the ENTERPRISE before his promotion to the starboard seat? Find out as we go below decks for "Ensign Chekov," heading your way in January, 2016.

A god cannot die, and a story never truly ends. Dr. McCoy confronts Captain Kirk with a staggering discovery -- Lt. Carolyn Palamas is pregnant with the child of Apollo. Or is she? Find out in "Of Woman Born," courtesy of photomanipulator extraordinaire, John Byrne.

An alien threat that numbers in the millions, and star systems are already dying. What can the crew of the Enterprise do—alone!

Note: The digital edition (9/14/2016) for this issue was released before the print edition.

A chance encounter with a drifting ship leads the crew of the Enterprise to a world where the most obscene thing imaginable is the human face! Captain Kirk must face the greatest test of his belief in the Prime Directive.
James Kirk faces the greatest challenge of his life when his own brother is accused of murder!
A mysterious Traveler is pursued by a ruthless robotic horde. Or is he? Jim Kirk must answer that question before his ship and crew are lost!

issue_title: Time Out of Joint; Home; Those Who Who Play With Cats...
description: Captain Kirk is torn from his timeline. Every corner he turns, every door he opens, throws him into a different day, a different year—and a different danger.

On a world locked deep into an ice age, Kirk and the crew investigate the disappearance of a team of Federation scientists, and discover a long-lost civilization whose only survivor is intent on saving them… even if it kills them!

issue_title: What Pain It Is To Drown; R.H.I.P.
description:
Pulled down to a world made entirely of water, the Enterprise is in danger of literally flooding — while Spock and McCoy discover a sinister purpose behind this bizarre planet.

For thousands of years, it had drifted above the outer rim of the Galaxy, draining life from all the worlds it found there. Now, it has learned of the banquet of populous planets near the heart of the Milky Way, and is heading there at terrifying speed—with only the Enterprise standing in its way.

John Byrne continues his new Star Trek photonovel adventures! In “Core,” from the raging heart of the galaxy comes a message that summons the crew of the Starship: Enterprise on their most bizarre and dangerous mission. A message sent by their own captain… ten centuries earlier!

issue_title: Isolation; Like A Shadow... ...Like A Dream
description: Captain Kirk has found himself all alone on the Enterprise before—but what happens when each individual member of the crew finds themselves in a similar state? And who is behind this... isolation?

issue_title: The Enemy of My Enemy; The Rhyme of the Ancient Mariner
description: The enemy of my enemy… is not my friend. But Kirk and Kor find themselves forced to work together against a common foe. Alliance, or a chance for deadly betrayal?

Kirk and his crew venture into the past, only to discover it is nothing like what their history books teach—no trace of the devastation of World War III and the Eugenics Wars. What can have caused such a divergence? The answer is to be found in “An Unexpected Yesterday."

John Byrne continues his new Star Trek photonovel adventures with two tales for the price of one, as the crew of the Starship: Enterprise faces a menace three millions years in the making, plus something more recent but no less deadly. Presenting a follow-up to the classic episode "The Doomsday Machine," as well as “Robot,” a brand-new tale of murder and mystery.

John Byrne continues his new Star Trek photonovel adventures with “Made Out of Mudd” – Harry Mudd has gotten under Jim Kirk's skin before, but never quite like this… alien artifacts, Klingons, and a mad man's schemes add up to headaches for the Captain and his crew. All that, plus Tribbles!!

John Byrne continues his new Star Trek photoplay adventures with “A Scent of Ghosts” and “Memoriam.” Past and Present collide, as the Enterprise takes aboard a special figure from Spock’s past, only to find themselves haunted by an mystery from years before. Plus, a sad farewell.
One word: Borg!
Captain Kirk sets off alone on a mission that will carry him 200 years into his past… but he won’t be alone for long—Gary Seven returns!

issue_title: The Survival Equation; The Hollow Man
description: Andrea, Ruk, Exo III — names that conjure grim memories for James Kirk. What, then, happens when the killer androids start showing up by the dozen? Plus, a special guest star who’s bound to surprise!
A mysterious message draws Mr. Spock on a solo mission to a distant part of the Federation, where an old friend awaits, as well as a menace with the potential to threaten the entire galaxy.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
It's 1,001 years later…and guess who's joining the Legion of Super-Heroes? It's just what you think…and nothing you expect!

Supergirl joins the Legion of Super-Heroes. However, she thinks the Legion is only a figment of her imagination.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
Learn more about the newest member of the Legion as the team tries to come to terms with the identity of this powerhouse blonde from the 21st century!

While in the 31st Century, Supergirl believes she is undergoing Tarukor, a Kryptonian rite of passage where a Kryptonian undergoes a lengthy dream-state before being deemed an adult, much to the dismay of several Legion of Super-Hero members. Cosmic Boy and Saturn Girl officially offer Supergirl a chance to join the Legion, which she accepts. All across the planet, Supergirl is received with cheers and praise, being a monumental hero from her time in the 21st Century. Certain members of the Legion try to inform her that she is in reality and not a dream, but some coincidental things occur that seem to argue that point. Meanwhile, the Dominators are scheming to handle the planet Earth.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
Where did Supergirl come from? Whatever happened to Brainiac 5, and just what did he do with Dream Girl's body? Who is Dream Boy? Plus, which of the Legionnaires has a secret identity-as a Science Police officer?

The Science Police are dealing with a potential machine uprising. It is revealed that Chameleon is working an espionage mission for the Legion of Super-Heroes by infiltrating the Science Police as an officer. The Legion of Super-Heroes assist the Science Police in their battle against the robots, thanks to Supergirl's enhanced senses, and defeat them. Before they left to help the Science Police, some leaders of the planet Naltor are upset to find that the Legion has still not sent the body of Dream Girl back to her home planet. They Legion goes to the secret lab of Brainiac 5 to learn that he has the body of Dream Girl with the intent of bringing her back to life. While at the lab, they are met with Dream Boy, a native of Naltor who is sent by the UP to replace Dream Girl on the Legion.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
Chameleon takes center stage as he puts his detective skills to work on a challenging case that could have major consequences for 31st century Earth! Plus, get to know the Legion's newest member-no, it's not Supergirl!

Chameleon is framed for murder. He explains what really happened to the Science Police and how a woman from the planet Titan named Jeyra Entinn, who came to the Science Police as a consultant, was really the killer. He is proven innocent and leaves, but jeopardizes his espionage mission since the SP now know he was masquerading as a Science Police officer. Meanwhile, Brainiac 5 takes Element Lad and Light Lass and takes the bodies of Dream Girl and Lemnos with him, disappearing, leaving the rest of the Legion in hot water with Dream Girl's people. Also, Supergirl goes to Theena to try to find someone named Seiss, an alien she saved from a falling wall. Theena informs Supergirl that she cannot find him.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
Brainiac wants to bring Dream Girl back from the dead…and only the memories of a deadly enemy can help!

Brainiac 5 moves closer to bringing Dream Girl back to life. Meanwhile, eight of Colossal Boy's people, the giants who reside in the Antarctic, are caught trying to steal eight art pieces around the world. A small group of Legionnaires is sent to each spot to stop them, but Supergirl shows up at each one to save the day. Cosmic Boy finds himself falling in love with her.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
The Legion struggles against the mighty giants of Colossal Boy's hometown! And with Brainiac's resurrection plan in action, can the Legion trust him to play God?

Spoilers

Colossal Boy is in the prison in Big City, interrogating the eight giants who tried to pilfer art pieces around the world. Before too long, the eight giants are broken out of prison by Nemesis Kid, Polar Boy and Kid Quake. It seems they are all united and they beat Colossal Boy before they leave. Meanwhile, Brainiac 5 comes to the completion of his goal to bring Dream Girl back to life, but her body instantly disappears. When Brainiac 5 goes to sleep, he gets to speak to Dream Girl.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
Supergirl's new boyfriend explores the feelings he has for her as the Legion takes on a foe who has recruited others who can target and exploit their every weakness!

Shadow Lass is upset about Ultra Boy's obsession over Supergirl. Karate Kid intervenes and makes everything fine. Meanwhile, Sun Boy and the former Terra Firma are investigating a Dominator colony but find it only inhabited by one super-strong Dominator. That team gets defeated and wakes up on a strange spaceship that explodes shortly after.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
A 31st century blowout! Supergirl on Krypton? Shadow Lass running for Legion Leader? Plus an ending no one will see coming!

The Legion take Supergirl to Rokyn, a place where Kryptonian descendants live now. Rokyn used to be the bottle city of Kandor. The Legion brought her there so she could realize that she isn't dreaming everything up, the Legion is a reality. While on Rokyn, the Legion try to stop a heist on a museum, a heist that includes Jeyra Entinn and Polar Boy. During the fight, Saturn Girl picks up a stray thought somewhere and it's revealed to be Mon-El. Meanwhile, Element Lad and Triplicate Girl go underground to see if the machine rising from months ago has completely been quelled. While there, Triplicate Girl comes across a boy named Plant Kid and brings him to the Legion. However, Plant Kid has ulterior motives.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
The team struggles against a Legion of super-powered villains that may be connected to the mysteries surrounding Supergirl. Plus, the return of a Legionnaire you never thought you'd see again. And just who is Tarik the Mute?

The Legion meet Mon-El, a denizen of the Phantom Zone.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
A longtime fan-favorite hero has escaped his centuries-long exile from the Phantom Zone and owes a tremendous debt to those who set him free. Too bad it's not the Legion!

The Wanderers, led by Light Lass and Lightning Lad's older brother Mekt Ranzz, raid the Legion of Super-Heroes headquarters to abduct four members to join their cause. The four members are Light Lass, Star Boy, Ultra Boy and Karate Kid. Meanwhile, Mon-El escapes form the Phantom Zone and Brainiac 5, with the assistance of Dream Boy, is able to concoct a serum that would save Mon-El from his deadly lead poisoning. When Mon-El is healed, he is suddenly teleported to the Wanderers.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
The Dominators' plan to destroy Earth reaches fruition as the Robot Rebellion sweeps the planet! And with key Legionnaires having defected to the “Adult Legion,” Cosmic Boy knows this is a war the team can't win!

The Legion of Super-Heroes searches for the missing teammates and finds them with the help of Supergirl's enhanced senses. When they arrive to return them back, they find that the kidnapper was a group called the Wanderers and they are being led by Lightning Lad and Light Lass' brother, Mekt Ranzz. Mekt Ranzz explains that they are working independent of the United Planets and he didn't kidnap the Legion members, he wanted to recruit them to his team. In the middle of this, they all get word that there is a machine uprising in Megatokyo. Supergirl, Brainiac 5, Ultra Boy and Mon-El race to Megatokyo to stop the revolt. It seems too simple at first until a giant robot rises from underground, shaped like a giant Dominator. It's mostly hollow and Brainiac 5 realizes that is is housing a red chemical. It releases the chemical, making it visible from outer space.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
Sibling rivalry confronts the Legion as Lightning Lad and Mekt Ranzz are forced to go from head-to-head to side-by-side! But will even the combined might of these brothers be enough to fend off the Dominators’ Enforcers?

The Legion of Super-Heroes and the Wanderers fight back against the Dominators who have unleashed an AI virus that has taken control of every piece of machinery on Earth, including the Legion flight rings and the teleporters. Invisible Kid, trying to save a UP delegate from dying, uses his flight ring and his arm explodes. Meanwhile, it is revealed that the Dominators have kidnapped Sun Boy and Terra Firma a while back, analyzing their DNA to create super-powered Dominators to invade Earth. While Cosmic Boy tries to protect the UP delegates, he is attacked by a group of Dominators.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
The Legion and the Wanderers have joined forces to take the Dominator War away from Earth and to an unfamiliar realm where life is cheap and victory is dear. And at long last, the Dominators' link to the events of 52 is revealed!

Dream Girl visits Dream Boy, her replacement on the Legion of Super-Heroes, and informs him how he can help save the Earth. Meanwhile, Cosmic Boy has devised a plan that has brought the combined might of the Legion of Super-Heroes and the Wanderers to Dominion, the Dominators world. They fight, ready to free Earth.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
The surviving Legionnaires and Wanderers face off against the entirety of the Dominator Empire to prevent the destruction of the galaxy!

The reason for the Dominators attack is revealed. Long ago, the Dominators assembled with other planets to take care of the potential threat of Earth. This incident is known as the Invasion. At the conclusion of the Invasion, the Dominators were beat and it left a long-lasting psychological scar on that race. Since that encounter, Earth and Dominion have had no contact. Centuries later, they have made it official with a pact called the Non-Aggression Treaty. However, after that treaty was place, Booster Gold arrived on the Dominators homeworld to steal a weapon. This occurred during the events of 52, and the Dominators took that to mean that there were 52 planets set up to attack the Dominators. This prompted them to attack the satellite planets and outposts of the United Planets and their eventual attack on Earth.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
description:
It's a turning-point issue for the Legionnaires as a longtime member makes a startling decision that will affect the entire team!

The Legion of Super-Heroes, the Wanderers and Terra Firma decide what to do with the Dominators now that they are beaten. Just because they are beaten now doesn't mean that they won't attack again in the future. Cosmic Boy decides that Brainiac 5 should create a bomb that would destroy Dominion. Mon-El delivers the bomb, sacrificing himself in the process. However, this is all a ruse and the bomb was actually a Phantom Zone transporter that was able to teleport the whole planet of Dominion. It also brought Mon-el back to the Phantom Zone so he can remain alive while Brainiac 5 can come up with a permanent cure for him. The reason Cosmic Boy created the ruse was so that Mekt Ranzz wouldn't continue to fight for his ideals and accidentally let loose all the Dominators trying to free Mon-el. Coincidentally, this is also the time when a new Legion of Super-Heroes leader is being voted on. Cosmic Boy takes some time alone to think if he wants to be the Legion leader or take some time off when he's approached by three figures who claim to be from the 41st Century, from a team called the Knights Templus. They explain how Cosmic Boy has inspired them to create their team in the future and wants him to join them. When Saturn Girl and Lightning Lad search to for him to inform him who the leader of the Legion is, they find his flight ring on a statue of the original members of the Legion of Super-Heroes.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
issue_title: The Quest for Cosmic Boy: Prologue
description:
The Dominators storyline comes to a surprising conclusion that will change the lives of the Legionnaires irrevocably!

The votes are in! The newest leader of the Legion of Super-Heroes is Supergirl. She meets up with Tenzil Kem, a prosecutor from the United Planets hired to find if Cosmic Boy is responsible for the death of the entire race of Dominators. Brainiac 5 informs Supergirl that he knows the three most likely areas where Cosmic Boy would be found and Supergirl sends three teams to scout each area. Ultra Boy, Shadow Lass and Atom Girl visit the planet of Lallor. Supergirl, Saturn Girl and Lightning Lad go to the Gobi Rainforest on Earth. Sun Boy, Star Boy and Mekt Ranzz go to Ranzz's homeworld of Winath, where they are met with Tenzil Kem.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
issue_title: The Quest for Cosmic Boy: Lord of Lighting, Part 1 of 2
description:
“The Quest for Cosmic Boy” begins! The Legionnaires have lost their longtime leader, Cosmic Boy-but was he captured by enemies or did he flee responsibility for his “war crime”? The Legion's newly elected leader makes a hard decision her first day on the job and sends out teams of Legionaires in search of Cosmic Boy. Will they be prepared for what they find?

Star Boy, Sun Boy and Mekt Ranzz have arrived on the planet of Winath to follow the trail of the missing Cosmic Boy. They are met by the United Planets Special Prosecutor, Tenzil Kem, who is in charge of the investigation of Cosmic Boy and if he's responsible for war crimes. Due to the rough climate of Winath, most buildings and businesses are below ground. The Legionnaires and Tenzil Kim cannot find anyone on the surface and go underground for any clues as to Cosmic Boy's whereabouts. It is underground that Mekt Ranzz comes across a symbol that says "Validus". Mekt gets angry, believing that Tenzil created the symbol, but it wasn't. Mekt then goes on to explain the importance of Validus, how he is considered the Lord of Lightning, and there's a cult based on him. Mekt was chosen to fulfill a prophecy of Validus and bring him to Winath, but failed in his endeavor. Meanwhile, Tenzil is met by twin children who tell him that they will lead him to the town's mayor but lead him into a trap, a silo filling up with wheat. The Legion members are attacked by the citizens of Winath who all appear to have lightning-based powers and are in the cult of Validus.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
issue_title: The Quest for Cosmic Boy: Lord of Lightning, Part 2 of 2
description: “The Quest for Cosmic Boy,” part 2 of 5. The United Planets blames Cosmic Boy for war crimes! Star Boy and Sun Boy must clear his name. But they'll have to outsmart a certain matter-eating prosecutor and overcome a shocking development on planet Winath that threatens Lightning Lad's family.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
issue_title: The Quest for Cosmic Boy: E.R.G.ONOMICS, Part 1 of 2
description:
“The Quest for Cosmic Boy,” part 3 of 5. Why is Cosmic Boy wanted for war crimes? Why is his biggest rival, Mekt Ranzz, defending him? Will special prosecutor Tenzil Kem be forced to eat his own words? And what is the Cult of Validus? There are shocking developments on the lightning world of Winath!

SPOILERS

A contingent of Legionnaires, consisting of Atom Girl, Shadow Lass and Timber Wolf, find themselves on the planet of Lallor to search for their former leader, Cosmic Boy. When they reach Lallor, they are attacked by soldiers there. Lallor is in the middle of a civil war between two factions, one that wants to join the United Planets and one that does not. The president, who wants to join the UP, has heard word that his opposing faction has hired a super-powered assassin to kill him. When the Legionnaires arrive on the planet, the Lallor soldiers mistakingly believe that it is them. Before too long, the actual assassin reveals himself. He was a former Legion of Super-Heroes tryout member called E.R.G-1. He explains, upon meeting with the Legionnaires, what occurred in the past and how Cosmic Boy, Saturn Girl and Lightning Lad left him to die on his first mission, which is a skewed version of the story. After E.R.G.-1 blasts part of the roof on Timber Wolf, Timber Wolf knocks the debris away to reveal that he has been transformed into a much more feral version of himself.

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
issue_title: The Quest for Cosmic Boy: E.R.G.ONOMICS, Part 2 of 2
description: “The Quest for Cosmic Boy,” part 4 of 5. The quest for Cosmic Boy continues on the war-torn world of Lallor where Timber Wolf, Atom Girl and Shadow Lass are suspected of assassinating the planet's President! But they would rather face every cop and soldier on Lallor than fight the walking H-bomb known as E.R.G.!

series_title: Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes
issue_title: The Quest for Cosmic Boy: Epilogue
description:
“The Quest for Cosmic Boy,” part 5 of 5. The quest for Cosmic Boy concludes as Brainiac 5's secret is revealed! Plus, Lightning Lad's place in the Legion gets a shocking change, Supergirl spends her last day as a Legionnaire, and the trans-temporal menace of Evolvo-Lad intensifies!

This is the last issue of Supergirl and the Legion of Super-Heroes. This volume is continued in Legion of Super-Heroes # 37.
